tools.name: rws_project_list
tools.description: List projects and confirmed foundations.

tools.name: rws_record_get
tools.description: Read one exact record or historical version.

tools.name: rws_get_context
tools.description: Read concise project/task context, completed facts, pending gaps and suggested actions. Suggestions are not execution authorization.

tools.name: rws_code_find
tools.description: Find existing implementations before building new code. Returns exact identities and declared contracts; supplied check evidence is not independent verification.

tools.name: rws_result_query
tools.description: Find exact outputs across runs in this project. Retains producer, case, configuration and observation coordinates; never silently merges repeats.

tools.name: rws_project_create
tools.description: Create an independent project and its initial confirmed foundation; no demonstration records are inherited.

tools.name: rws_research_save
tools.description: Save a research question or optional hypothesis. implementationLinks declares intended uses of exact spec/code revisions before execution; these links are not evidence and do not decide scientific validity.

hypothesis.description: A concrete hypothesis. Explicit null clears an optional statement; omission preserves it when updating. Judged research remains subject to human review.

implementationLinks.description: Declared research purposes, not actual execution or evidence. Pin a specification before implementation, or reference existing code. Omission preserves existing links; [] clears them.

judgment.description: Human scientific decision. Explicit null removes it only with human authority; omission preserves the previous decision.

tools.name: rws_experiment_save
tools.description: Save an experiment and bind its confirmed project foundation; does not execute it.

tools.name: rws_code_register
tools.description: Register an immutable code identity and explicit parent references; never reads or runs the path.

tools.name: rws_run_register
tools.description: Record an actual run and status. Registration never launches a program; producer bindings are immutable.

record.description: For an existing id, provide only fields to change; omitted fields are preserved. A new id still requires a complete valid record.

tools.name: rws_artifact_register
tools.description: Register an immutable output with its actual producer and configuration. For a legacy output with unresolved provenance, explicitly set provenance=unresolved with source evidence and a description; never invent a producer run. Does not read arbitrary files.

provenance.description: known requires an actual producer run; unresolved preserves legacy outputs with source evidence and a description of what remains unknown.

tools.name: rws_protocol_register
tools.description: Register immutable evaluation metric definitions, preprocessing, aggregation and missing-data policy.

tools.name: rws_dataset_register
tools.description: Register an immutable dataset version and exact sample IDs.

tools.name: rws_conversation_save
tools.description: Register an existing conversation reference; does not create or send a chat.

tools.name: rws_evaluation_import
tools.description: Validate and register existing typed evaluation results with fixed protocol/code/input versions; does not compute metrics.

tools.name: rws_comparison_save
tools.description: Save exact comparison inputs and fixed/varying conditions without moving their original producers.

tools.name: rws_analysis_save
tools.description: Save observations, interpretation and limitations; manual analysis may omit code.

tools.name: rws_report_create_revision
tools.description: Create a report version with immutable foundation and transitive evidence snapshots.

tools.name: rws_spec_save
tools.description: Define a method-level contract before implementation. Saves a new draft or ready revision; implementations pin an exact ready revision. Cases/configurations belong to runs, not method contracts.

record.description: For an existing id, provide only fields to change; omitted fields are preserved. A new id still requires a complete valid record.

tools.name: rws_server_save
tools.description: Register a versioned local/SSH workspace using an SSH alias, never credentials. Registration does not connect.

tools.name: rws_repository_save
tools.description: Register an existing checkout and its exact server reference. Does not clone, inspect or change Git.

tools.name: rws_environment_save
tools.description: Register a versioned execution directory and Python executable in the registered checkout. Does not execute or probe.

tools.name: rws_usage_save
tools.description: Reference precise artifacts in a target experiment, including cross-project reuse. Original producer remains unchanged.

tools.name: rws_usage_remove
tools.description: Revoke a material usage without deleting source artifacts or other uses.

tools.name: rws_overview_propose
tools.description: Save a proposed foundation revision for human review; this does not apply it.

tools.name: rws_overview_apply
tools.description: Human review only. MCP cannot approve its own suggestion; use the application review screen.

tools.name: rws_overview_dismiss
tools.description: Human review only. MCP cannot approve its own suggestion; use the application review screen.

tools.name: rws_project_stages_set
tools.description: Human-only current-stage decision. Browsing and completed runs never advance stages.

tools.name: rws_amendment_propose
tools.description: Propose an audited metadata/source/lineage/recovery correction for an exact record. Does not rewrite the source or approve the correction.

tools.name: rws_amendment_apply
tools.description: Human-only approval of an exact pending amendment. Raw records and previous report snapshots remain unchanged.

tools.name: rws_amendment_dismiss
tools.description: Human-only dismissal of an exact pending amendment. Keeps the proposal history without applying its patch.

tools.name: rws_operation_propose
tools.description: Propose a literal reviewed Git/task operation. No execution occurs. Read-only inspections may be claimed by an explicit local runner; workspace/process mutations need exact human approval.

tools.name: rws_operation_approve
tools.description: Human only: approve this exact operation plan. Approval never launches it.

tools.name: rws_operation_dismiss
tools.description: Human only: dismiss this exact operation plan. Approval never launches it.

tools.name: rws_metrics_append
tools.description: Append actual process measurements in batches under the run's pinned processMetrics contract. Identical points deduplicate; conflicting values never overwrite. Does not run a model.

tools.name: rws_metrics_query
tools.description: Read bounded process series and compatible alignments. Reuse throughSequence on every page; null stays missing, with no interpolation.

tools.name: rws_metrics_snapshot
tools.description: Freeze the selected run metrics through a previously read sequence into one immutable metric-history artifact. Includes complete definitions and points; rejects over 5000 points instead of silently truncating.
